reason: I don't go to fabric shops' own websites, I type the fabric into Allegro, sort by price with delivery and take the cheapest Smart offer. If TextilWorld happens to come out on top there, fine, but nothing here gives me a reason to go to textilworld.pl or look for them by name.
objection: I don't know if they'd get it to me by the date I need it, and on their own site I'd pay delivery on top of 14.90, so it ends up dearer than an Allegro Smart offer.
would_change_my_mind: Their Allegro listing coming up cheapest with Smart free delivery and a guaranteed delivery date.
